decisions.reason: The competitor is selected only as the design reference; the supplied context explicitly preserves the client's branding, logo, content, and color scheme.
Selecting a visual design reference does not change the existing mobile-friendly requirement.
The design-reference choice does not alter the master site's role, national positioning, or booking arrangement.
The source chooses a visual reference and does not change location-selector behavior, options, or routing destinations.
The visual-reference decision does not alter the requirement to reuse the Seattle-based format for future locations without redesign.
Using the competitor as a visual reference leaves the dedicated-page model, current locations, and cross-location consistency requirement unchanged.
The source does not add, remove, reorder, or otherwise change any required homepage section or offering visibility rule.
The design-reference choice has no entailed effect on Wix booking, booking hosting, or Seattle's booking activation behavior.
The source concerns visual direction only and does not change any location account, data, reporting, or access isolation rule.
The competitor-reference decision does not change Seattle's coming-soon mode, required sections, button label, or opening transition.
The source does not change the VIP email signup behavior or its Join VIP List button label.
Selecting a design reference does not affect separate location payment setups or payout handling.
